arStrings.szText: If no more than {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} of your Demons has been alive for longer than {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds then you gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction and every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|%|]{/c} Base Life you lose from Direct Damage generates {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"|1|]{/c} Dominance.
